YOUR NEXT DISCOVERY

Bring your game.

Paste a PGN game from Chess.com, Lichess, or anywhere you play. You can also start with a FEN position.

Everything stays on this device.

Your personal analysis room.

Elo Pal runs the free Stockfish engine in your browser. Games and settings stay on this device. Once installed, analysis works offline.

  1. One click from Chess.com or Lichess. Open a game or analysis page, then click Elo Pal's toolbar icon. Elo Pal reads the game’s PGN or main move list, opens it here, and starts a local review. On Lichess it uses the displayed game’s PGN export. If the page doesn't expose a complete game, paste or upload its PGN instead.
  2. Review the story. The summary shows both players’ accuracy, move grades, the opening, and the game graph. Select Analyze game for manual imports, then Start Review when it finishes. Colored badges beside the last moved piece show its grade. Press Explain to hear Coach Cat’s ideas, Best line to explore an engine continuation, or Next key moment to jump to an important move. Best line starts at the displayed position; use Previous, Next, Play, or the numbered line moves to walk through it. Return to game restores the original position.
  3. Follow your curiosity. Select any move, switch to Analysis, or click pieces to try a different continuation. Use Return to game when you're done.

Hear the moves

Moves have distinct local sounds: a soft tap for an ordinary move, a deeper capture, two taps for castling, and different chimes for check, promotion, and checkmate. Use the speaker above the board or press M to mute. Your sound preference is remembered. Engine calculations stay silent.

Learn the opening

The opening explorer identifies known move sequences from a bundled local library. Open the card to see its name, variation, ECO code, ideas for both sides, and useful continuations. A tan Book badge marks a recognized opening move independently of the engine’s preference.

Great moves, brilliant moves & accuracy

A blue ! marks a Great move: Elo Pal detects a critical choice by comparing the engine’s two leading legal candidates. It is a local estimate, and may change with deeper analysis.

A turquoise !! marks a sound material sacrifice detected by Elo Pal. It requires sufficiently deep engine scores, a new offer of a valuable piece, and a legal way for the opponent to gain material. Ordinary trades, forced moves, and immediate checkmates do not receive this label. Some sacrifices may be missed; deeper analysis can change the grade.

Move grades and accuracy use Elo Pal's own formulas. They are not Chess.com's proprietary ratings. Coach Cat points out concrete threats, legal engine continuations, and specific positional plans for the board you are viewing, including explored variations. These explanations use local chess rules and Stockfish, cover detected ideas rather than every possibility, and need no online AI or subscription.
